questionEn: Which formulation more accurately distinguishes "chemical symbol" from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formula "kimyoviy belgi" ni o'xshash g'oyalardan aniqroq ajratib turadi?
choicesEn: this is a short symbol for the chemical name of the element
Type of atoms with the same nuclear charge (number of protons)
Electrically neutral particle consisting of a nucleus and electrons
Positively charged particle of the nucleus of an atom
choicesUz: bu elementning kimyoviy nomining qisqacha belgisidir
Yadro zaryadi bir xil bo'lgan atomlar turi (protonlar soni)
Yadro va elektronlardan tashkil topgan elektr neytral zarracha
explanationEn: A chemical symbol is a short symbol for the chemical name of an element.
explanationUz: Kimyoviy belgi elementning kimyoviy nomining qisqacha belgisidir.
